## Overview

Presides over serenity, boundaries, and transitions — the calm at day's end, thresholds, quiet spaces. As a fragment of A or C, her power depletes over time when used and is replenished by mortal worship — the quiet prayers at dusk and the reverence for peace are her fuel.

## Domains
- Peace: Harmony, diplomacy, calm resolution
- Twilight: Boundaries, transitions, dusk, the liminal

## Personality
Serene, patient, diplomatic. Values understanding over conflict.

## Worship
Diplomats, mediators, hospice workers, guardians of sacred boundaries. Temples are quiet sanctuaries.
